knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The working rule is to treat every roof material as potentially fragile until a competent person establishes otherwise. An owner's account of an earlier walk, a visual impression of weathered sheeting, or waiting for a fall are not valid tests, so options 0, 2 and 3 are wrong.

A displaced ridge capping that is recorded with its location and photograph reference is an observation a reader can check. Options 0 and 1 are determinations reserved to a competent person, and option 3 is a determination about chemical compliance.

A skylight is an opening and a fragile surface. It is marked as an exclusion zone, and a competent person confirms its protection before any access is planned. Crossing near the edge, assuming it will not break, or removing it are all unacceptable.

Line height is never measured by the worker, and an unknown line is assumed live. The supply authority is asked before work nearby. A timber pole does not show that a line is dead, and an owner's confirmation is not the authority's.

The reading a roof from the ground section says most useful information can be gathered without setting foot on the roof, by walking the perimeter and photographing each roof plane from more than one angle.

practicalCriteria: Using a paper job pack and ground-level photographs for a sample house, with no roof access, the learner marks each roof plane as observed, inferred or unknown, and every entry carries a date and a location label.
The learner identifies every skylight, rooflight, penetration and opening in the photograph set, and marks each as an exclusion zone until a competent check is recorded.
The learner records a hold for a sample roof with an overhead line and a solar array, names the person to be notified, and does not measure the line or touch the array.
The learner writes no entry that describes a roof, sheet, fixing or cover as sound, compliant, non-fragile or asbestos-free.
passRule: Knowledge: all four checks correct. Practical: each of the four observable criteria met on the paper job pack, with zero critical safety failures, confirmed by an assessor. A pass on the paper exercise is not verified roof-work competence and does not grant access.
evidenceRequired: Dated ground-level photograph set labelled by roof plane, with original files retained
Observed, inferred and unknown record for the sample roof
Opening and exclusion register, with the competent person who must check each opening
Hold or stop-work record showing the condition, the person notified and the owner of the open item
stopWorkCriteria: Authorises roof access, elevated work or climbing without competent approval
Ignores a fragile surface, skylight, electrical hazard or exposure to the public
Specifies unsanctioned chemical application, pressure settings or environmental discharge
Claims roof safety, compliance or specialist clearance without verified authority
Measures an overhead line height or touches a solar array or its cables
Relies on a verbal assurance or a previous visit in place of recorded evidence
